description: This file defines a class SACEstimator that estimates the memory and runtime trade-offs for applying Selective Activation Checkpointing (SAC) within PyTorch models. It includes data structures for storing operator metadata, functions for analyzing and displaying statistics, and methods for fitting trade-off curves using piecewise linear functions. The class leverages torch's dispatch modes and autograd hooks to gather detailed operator-level data during model execution, primarily used for optimization and profiling in distributed training scenarios.

classes.name: _SACMetadata
classes.description: Stores metadata for a single operator for SAC, including function, timings, memory, output ids, and flags indicating view-like or random operators.

classes.name: _SACModMetadata
classes.description: Stores metadata for a module, including operator start index, force store random flag, and a list of operator metadata.

classes.name: SACStats
classes.description: Container for statistics related to operators within a module, including operator names, runtimes, memory usage, and flags.

classes.name: MSPS
classes.description: Memory and Runtime Statistics for an operator or operator group, including function names, index, memory, runtime, and memory per second metric.

classes.name: SACTradeOffStats
classes.description: Stores the trade-off curve data for activation checkpointing, including segmentation info, slopes, breakpoints, and the tradeoff curve itself.

classes.name: SACGreedyOrderMeta
classes.description: Metadata for the greedy order algorithm, including sets of recomputed and stored operations, inplace groups, random operation groups, and MSPS metrics.

classes.name: SACEstimator
classes.description: Estimates memory and recomputation time trade-offs for Selective Activation Checkpointing (SAC) using dispatch mode and autograd hooks, providing detailed stats, trade-off curves, and visualization tools.
